notes: Donut and Carl leave the guild and crawl the Floor 1 tunnels, fighting from Carl's shoulder with Magic Missile. She lands the party's first big kill (the Bad Llama, dealing 71% of the damage), levels up to 2, and raises Magic Missile to level 3. The book shows her Intelligence as 17 = base 12 (11 emergence + 1 Enhanced-Growth level-up) plus the Crown's +5, giving her 17 mana. (Her Strength and Charisma rose on the same level-up: Enhanced Growth grants +1 Strength, +1 Intelligence and +2 Charisma per level, so from her level-1 sheet of Str 11 / Int 11 / Cha 25 her level-2 base is 12 / 12 / 27. Book 1 ch10 states her strength was at 15 at level 5, which confirms the formula: 12 + 3 levels = 15.) The chapter ends with the party reaching a Floor 1 safe room.

add.name: Cast your first spell
add.note: Donut cast Magic Missile for the first time during the Bad Llama fight. Only Carl's summary reaches us, so the system's own wording is unknown.

add.name: Killed a mob
add.note: Donut's first mob kill — the Level 3 Bad Llama, to which she dealt 71% of the damage. The same system achievement Carl earned in ch02, but her notification is never shown.

add.name: Killed a mob a higher level than yourself
add.note: Donut (Level 1, then 2) helped kill the higher-level (Level 3) Bad Llama. The same system achievement Carl earned in ch03, but her notification is never shown.

sources.quote: Donut had leveled up to two after the llama battle.
I could see she currently had a 17 in intelligence, giving her 17 mana points. Each zap of her spell cost five mana points.
Her skill level in the spell went up to three.
I saw the safe room glowing green on the edge of the minimap… We entered the safe room.
Donut got the same, plus a couple additional achievements for casting her first spell and finally killing something, along with killing a mob higher level than herself.

sources.field: stats.strength / stats.charisma (derived from the stated rule)
sources.quote: After an initial boost to four random stats, all additional levels will automatically grant +1 to Strength and Intelligence. Charisma will gain +2 per level. No additional stat points will be received upon level-up.
